research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: the bank's site moved to a Next.js front end on https://mncbank.co.id in 2026 (https://www.mncbank.co.id now serves a bare 'Test Page' and the old /uploads/files/ links 404). Document lists were read from the site's own public API (https://webapi.mncbank.co.id/api/v1/public/financial-reports and /pages/by-slug/<slug>); every PDF was fetched with plain curl from https://webapi.mncbank.co.id/public/uploads/file-manager/general/... on 2026-11-03, no bot challenge. idx.co.id answers 403 and was not used. The four rights-issue schedules come from KSEI notices fetched directly from web.ksei.co.id (the bank's PUT VII-X prospectus links are dead and not archived).

TWO WRONG FILES ON THE BANK'S IR PAGE: (1) the 'Laporan Tahunan 2020' card serves the 2013 annual report of PT Bank ICB Bumiputera Tbk; the real AR2020 was taken from the Internet Archive copy of the bank's former URL https://mncbank.co.id/uploads/files/ANNUAL_REPORT_MNC_BANK_2020_web.pdf (snapshot 20220121103023). (2) every 'Laporan Keuangan Konsolidasian' (Dec 2023, Dec 2024, Dec 2025, Jun 2026...) on the bank's financial-report page is the consolidated FS of the PARENT PT MNC Kapital Indonesia Tbk (BCAP; total assets Rp29.0tn at Dec 2025). None of them is used; all FY figures come from the bank's own audited statements bound into each year's AR.

ENTITY / BASIS: PT Bank MNC Internasional Tbk (ex PT Bank ICB Bumiputera Tbk, renamed 2014; controlled by PT MNC Kapital Indonesia Tbk, 49.83% at 30 Jun 2026; Winfly Ltd 23.44%) has no subsidiaries or associates (AR2025 PDF p. 87). Its audited statements are single-entity; money fields carry basis 'consolidated' (validator rule, as for BBYB/MEGA), ratios 'bank_only' as printed (OJK definitions). equity_attr = total_equity. The AR highlight tables print a split of profit/comprehensive income between 'owners' and 'non-controlling interests' (AR2025 PDF p. 8: 40,748 / 41,027 for 2025) that has no basis in the audited statements - it mirrors the parent's ~50% stake - and is ignored. Auditor: KAP Kanaka Puradiredja, Suhartono (Nexia) since 2018.

UNITS: all FY2019-FY2025 audited statements and the 2025-2026 published reports are in Rp juta (divided by 1,000). loans_gross = related-party + third-party 'Kredit' lines before allowance; deposits = 'Simpanan' (customer deposits, excludes interbank). No restatement of any total between consecutive ARs (each AR's prior-year column equals the previous AR).

SHARES: two classes trade under BABP - series A (nominal Rp100) and series B (nominal Rp50, issued since the Apr 2019 PMTHMETD); counts add both. Share changes 2019-2026: PMTHMETD 12 Apr 2019 +1,640,000,000 @Rp50; PUT VII Dec 2019 +1,908,236,258; Warrant IV/V exercises 2020-2023; PUT VIII Sep 2021 +1,010,030,006; PMTHMETD 31 Jan 2022 +1,969,696,969 @Rp165; PUT IX Dec 2022/Jan 2023 +2,317,631,458; PUT X Dec 2023/Jan 2024 +10,699,834,125. The two private placements (non-pre-emptive) are not corporate-action types in the schema and are recorded here only. The EGMS of 21 Jun 2024 approved a further PMTHMETD of up to 4,445,899,735 shares (disclosure 15 May / 19 Jun 2024), but the share count is unchanged at 44,458,997,354 through 30 Jun 2026 (no issue made). No split, reverse split or bonus issue since listing (AR2025 PDF pp. 13, 86).

NO DIVIDENDS: the AGMS of every year 2020-2026 resolved not to distribute a dividend for FY2019-FY2025 (summary minutes cited in each payout_ratio); the bank still had an accumulated deficit of Rp536bn at Dec 2025. dividends is therefore empty and payout_ratio is 0 for FY2020-FY2025.

YEAR-END PRICES ARE DOUBTFUL - REVIEW AGAINST THE PRICE SERIES: the AR share-price tables are internally inconsistent. AR2024 and AR2025 print a monthly table whose December close (54 and 56) differs from the 'Triwulan IV' row of the quarterly table (71 and 58), which is in fact the October row; the monthly December closes are stored. AR2019-AR2023 print only quarterly tables (Q4 close 50, 50, 228, 119, 65) plus a closing-price chart that disagrees with the tables (Dec 2021 ~180, Dec 2022 ~100, Dec 2023 ~75; the 2022 chart is re-used unchanged in AR2023). The Q4 2021/2022 market caps also do not reconcile with year-end share counts. The table values are stored as printed with these doubts in each note; no official alternative (IDX is blocked) was available. FY2019/2020 at the Rp50 floor are low-risk.

RIGHTS ISSUES: four between 2019 and today - PUT VII (ex 2 Dec 2019, 6:1 @Rp50 + Warrant V), PUT VIII (ex 9 Sep 2021, 2:1 @Rp318), PUT IX (ex 9 Dec 2022, 10:3 @Rp130), PUT X (ex 14 Dec 2023, 5:2 @Rp75). PUT VII went ex BEFORE the FY2019 close, so the closest pre-ex annual-report close is FY2018 (Rp50, printed in AR2019 PDF p. 15; not storable in this schema). Each was heavily under-subscribed except PUT X, which was carried by capital advances from the main shareholders.

NOBU MERGER (news only, no bank filing found): from early 2023 OJK and the two banks talked about merging MNC Bank with PT Bank Nationalnobu Tbk (NOBU, Lippo) so the combined bank would reach KBMI 2; the target (Aug 2023, then mid-2024) slipped repeatedly. In Aug 2025 the cross-holdings were unwound in negotiated-market trades: Lippo's PT Prima Cakrawala Sentosa sold its 4,445,000,000 BABP series B shares (10.00%) to MNC Kapital (MNC Kapital's series B went 8,371,266,466 -> 12,816,266,466 between AR2024 PDF p. 553 and the Jun 2026 FS PDF p. 78) and MNC Land sold its NOBU stake. On 22-23 Nov 2025 OJK (Dian Ediana Rae) said the merger plan was cancelled and asked both owners to keep strengthening capital (Bisnis.com https://finansial.bisnis.com/read/20251122/90/1930838/fix-ojk-ungkap-merger-nobu-mnc-bank-babp-resmi-batal ; Kontan https://keuangan.kontan.co.id/news/merger-bank-nobu-dan-mnc-bank-batal-ojk-minta-perkuat-struktur-permodalan). AR2024/AR2025 (PDF p. 162/161) report no merger, acquisition or restructuring activity.

RATIO SOURCES: CAR, NPL gross/net, ROA, ROE, NIM, BOPO and LDR come from each year's own AR 'Rasio Keuangan' table (FY2025 values match the Dec 2025 OJK published report). AR2020-AR2022 label the liquidity ratio 'Loan to Funding Ratio (LFR)'; AR2023+ print the same numbers as LDR (no bonds issued, so the two coincide). CIR exists only from AR2025's five-year table (2021-2025); FY2020 CIR is null. CASA from the MD&A third-party-funds tables ((giro + tabungan) / DPK). Cost of credit, LAR and NPL coverage are not disclosed anywhere for FY2020-FY2025 (null); the 9M2026 'lar' is the OJK 'Kredit Kualitas Rendah' line.

2023 BALANCE-SHEET CHANGE: fixed assets jumped from Rp31.7bn (2022) to Rp1,001.7bn (2023) because the bank bought the land and MNC Bank Tower (ex MNC Financial Center, Jl. Kebon Sirih 21-27) from affiliates PT MNC Land Tbk and PT Global Mediacom Tbk for Rp801bn on 23 May 2023 (material/affiliated-transaction disclosure of 7 Jun 2023, https://webapi.mncbank.co.id/public/uploads/file-manager/general/fm-1775313294296-88764-20260404213454.pdf); funded around the same time as the PUT X capital advances. Not a restatement.

2026 IS DETERIORATING (real, not unit slips): 9M2026 profit Rp46.6bn (-22.8% YoY); customer deposits fell from Rp14.69tn (Dec 2025) to Rp11.32tn (Sep 2026), mostly time deposits, so LDR jumped to 105.83% and total assets dropped to Rp18.79tn; NPL gross 4.64%, KKR 34.84%, CAR 20.68%.
